newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise weaker on merger concern.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise weaker on merger concern.

text.p: Shares in utilities group Lyonnaise des Eaux were slightly weaker on Wednesday on worries about the terms of its planned merger with holding company Cie de Suez.

The Suez board on Tuesday unanimously backed the merger in principle and agreed to pay an exceptional dividend, for an unspecified amount, to Suez shareholders to reflect capital gains made last year.
One trader said the proposed dividend may have prompted a switch out of Lyonnaise shares into Suez shares. The dividend would mean Lyonnaise would get less Suez cash from the merger.
An analyst said there were fears that Lyonnaise might pay too much for Suez.
Lyonnaise shares were down 0.72 percent at 550 francs at 1040 GMT while Suez shares were up 0.21 percent at 286.5 francs compared to a 0.32 percent rise in the CAC-40 blue-chip index.
